fees.note: Town of Bainbridge parks page: RV and tent sites with electric and water $60 a night; $30 for Bainbridge residents, Passport America members and active or retired military; $500 a month, $1,800 a season.

Chenango County's 2026-2029 Cook Park rate sheet: camper site with water and 30-amp electric $50 a night in 2026 and $55 in 2027 (the 2027 rate is recorded; $60 in 2028, $65 in 2029); tent or lean-to $30 in 2026. Open Memorial Day weekend to Columbus Day weekend; cash or check only.
Union County pricing page: basic campsite $26 a day ($120 a week), waterfront campsite $30 a day ($150 a week); primitive tent $15. Books online through Campspot.

City of Galesburg fees: site with no services $19 a night, adding electricity $7, water $6 and sewer $8; full hookup $40. A $5 reservation fee applies to advance bookings (drop-ins don't pay it). Reservations by phone only; 2026 season Apr 9 - Oct 12.
Clay County FY 26/27 schedule of fees: fairgrounds RV hookups $40 a night each, plus sales tax and the Tourist Development Tax. Booked through the fairgrounds office by phone or email.

source: https://www.claycountygov.com/home/showpublisheddocument/9472/639264634026070000 (Clay County BCC FY 26/27 Schedule of Fees & Services v.08/25/26; read 2026-10-11)

fees.note: Limestone County rates effective 10/2024: $40 a day, $200 a week, $450 a month, plus 5% lodging tax on stays under 90 days; 30 riverfront sites with water, sewer and 30/50A; no tents.
City of Florence campground page: RV campsite $35 a day; seniors (62+) and holders of a handicap permit $30; dump $5. Reservations only; 14-day maximum May-August, 31 days September-April.
City of Citronelle: basic site (water and electric) $25 a day or $150 a week; waterfront site (water, electric, sewer) $30 a day, $180 a week, $600 a month.
Tulare County Parks fees: Balch Park camping $25 a day per campsite with two vehicles; extra vehicle $5, pets $5 a night. The 2026 season closes in mid to late October.
Explore Minnesota listing: a free-will offering for the first week, then $5 a day; 5 sites with electric and water, open May-September.

Shelby County Parks rate sheet (as of 2025-11-01): RV sites 1-5 $45 a night and 6-10 $40 in peak season (Mar 16 - Nov 15), $40 and $35 off-peak; tent sites $30 / $25; $3.50 reservation fee. Books online through ReserveAmerica.
City of Spencer fee schedule (fees effective 2025-01-20): Leach Park Campground electric and water sites $30 a night.

source: https://drive.google.com/file/d/17taEDddqGZNXwVtcvucHthIEd7-XAXZM/view (the 'Fee Schedule' linked from the city's Parks & Recreation page; read 2026-10-11)

fees.note: City of Sandpoint WebTrac: 40-ft full-hookup 30A sites $51.35 a night, 55-ft full-hookup 50A sites $66.75 (peak season fee, the same for residents and non-residents). Season about Apr 10 - Oct 15; no restrooms, showers or tents.
RoverPass Instant Book quote for Tue 10 - Wed 11 Nov 2026 (Skamania County's 'reserve online' link): 30/50A RV sites $35 a night, non-electric $30, rigs to 40 ft. July 2027 wasn't bookable yet.
City of Chehalis rec1 catalog: Stan Hedwall RV Park's 28 RV spaces (electric and water) $50 a night.

source: https://secure.rec1.com/WA/chehalis-wa/catalog (Stan Hedwall RV Park tab, getLocationFacilities rates; read 2026-10-11)

fees.note: Village of Silverton 2026 pricing, plus GST: creekside sites C$25, lakeside C$33, lakefront and the one electrified site C$55; extra vehicle or tent C$15. All sites are booked online.
